dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate
jey (file:///D:/codeWork/jev-dsh/repo/packages/adapter-dsh/dist/src/jey-plugin.js): ConfigError: invalid Jey configuration: ENFORCE_WITH_MOCK@/provider/kind

versionComparison.pluginThrowsAtApply: warns and serves without Jey: "dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate", exit 0, listening

versionComparison.how: the machine's own launcher under ~/.dsh (npx cache), same overlay and flags
versionComparison.pluginThrowsAtApply: aborts: "dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry jey", exit 1, never listens

hostFactsMeasured: dsh-app-boot boot() marks only requiredStartupEntryIds (agent-loop, webserver, modules, connection, headless-runner, acp, sdk-jsonrpc-server) as fatal; an out-of-tree entry that throws is collected as an inactive-entry warning and the tree keeps mounting, so a refused Jey config leaves a running host with no Jey.
the startup log exporter is levels {default: 2} (warn and above), so a plugin info line is dropped during boot — which is why mounting is announced through the Jey journal instead.
DSH_HOME is overridable via the DSH_HOME environment variable; profiles live at $DSH_HOME/profiles/<name> and cordis.yml is rewritten with the shipped root text on every boot.
limitations: no model turn was driven in either boot, so this says nothing about decision quality on a real loop (HOST-02 stays PARTIAL)
the launcher under ~/.dsh resolves its bundles from the npx cache, so the rc.2 row compares activation policy only, not a clean-room install
0.1.7-alpha.2 / 0.1.7-rc.x were not run; the boundary between aborting and warning is dated to somewhere in that range, not pinned to a commit
